claim: Offline wrapper clones each raw native output before advancing and flushes in-flight results after no schedulable sequences remain.
Owning clone is exported as RequestOutput.clone(uint64 pointer), returning unique_ptr; RequestOutputPool exports release rather than the generic pool.clone mentioned by a docstring.
Engine step consumes scheduler actions and uses deferred resource retirement; low-level outputs are pool-managed addresses.
Normal scheduling coordinates ALL/ANY prefill votes; ANY wins at coincident positive attempt points, while step zero suppresses ANY.
Block zero is reserved; capacity status distinguishes NEVER, OK, and LATER, and reference ownership controls reuse.
Unified execution orders current forward, prior post-processing, current sample, then immediate prompt/non-ZOS or deferred ZOS result handling.
WorkerStepState retains metadata/events across steps; MetadataZOS remaps current rows to matching prior rows with -1 for fresh sequences.
DP/CP/EP groups use distinct rearrangements; the DP2 CP2 EP4 example has CP pairs01/23 and DP pairs02/13.
Gather returns output only on destination and bypasses singleton groups; CP dict broadcast separates object metadata from tensor payload.
EPLB uses history-dependent greedy copy/placement policy with stable tie behavior; mapping structure is not a guarantee of global optimality.
Expert shuffle plans local/remote movement and staging so final physical slots match the logical map.
Compilation workers build matchers; pump attaches results and invokes engine admission callbacks, and replay restores mutable progress.
Model loading resolves architecture/configuration and checks parameter coverage under a loading watchdog before returning eval/no-gradient model.
Attention config gates sparse/sliding-window/packed-KV combinations and selected fusion paths.
InputMetadata distinguishes original positions, CP mirror views, valid masks, and real request count; views can differ in shape/stride/coordinate meaning.
Optional profiler captures engine/driver process rather than every CP follower, and has bounded request/start/stop/export lifetime.
total_tflops includes attention work and feeds MFU aggregation; it is an estimate rather than a timing event.
Native sequence tests reject incompatible dtype/noncontiguous arrays and validate copied token data.
Policy tests check forward/reverse mapping/count structure, deterministic results and input preservation.
Synthetic expert-encoded weights verify movement identity independently from full model math.
